not_bound.meaning: 보존 칸 다섯(legal_dispute_hold, business_reconciliation, retry_support, memory_residency, tax_accounting_records)은 retention_policy 객체에 {owner, status}로 이름과 주인만 있고 비어 있습니다. 보존 기간과 상한 값은 정해지지 않았습니다.
stage7 인증 export가 아닙니다. SignaturePort는 채택 경계입니다.

note: Local content-addressed manifest. Not stage7 authenticated export. No external key, cross-service cursor, watermark, or retention duration. retention_policy names five empty slots, each with an owner and a status of UNDETERMINED or DECISION_REQUIRED; no duration, bound, or timer is set, and the simulation retains every record with no automatic deletion (RETAIN_ALL_NO_AUTOMATIC_DELETION). Data classes journal, receipts, case_fixtures, derived_views, export_manifests, dev_hmac_key, and test_and_ci_artifacts hold no personal data by design (NO_PERSONAL_DATA_BY_DESIGN_V1). SignaturePort is the adoption seam. A shared HMAC key is integrity only, not authentication.
